name: Text statistics
summary: Count the characters, words and lines in a piece of text.
description:
Returns exact counts for the supplied text. Words are maximal runs of non-whitespace characters. Lines are counted by line breaks (
, 
 or ), and a final line without a trailing break still counts. Use this instead of estimating lengths yourself.

demonstrations.title: Two short lines
demonstrations.explanation: The newline is a character; the last line has no trailing break but still counts.

demonstrations.title: Windows line endings
demonstrations.explanation:
Each 
 is two characters but one line break.

limitations: Characters are Unicode code points, not grapheme clusters, so some emoji count as more than one.
Input longer than 1,000,000 characters is rejected.

failure_modes.condition: The 'text' argument is missing or is not a string.
failure_modes.symptom: The call is rejected before execution with an input validation error.
failure_modes.recovery: Pass the text as a JSON string under the key 'text'.
